verdict: Sales are profitable this period, but lead tracking and phone follow-up are leaking real money.
diagnosis: Ads generated $5,897 in purchases on $3,357 spend, but only 2 tracked leads at ~$1,678 each — tracking is broken or lead capture is failing.

signals.headline: Return on ad spend hit 1.76x
signals.detail: $5,897 in purchases against $3,357 spend this period. Healthy for a paid-only view, but purchase volume stayed low at 9.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads tracked in 28 days
signals.detail: Cost per lead reads ~$1,678, far above any wellness benchmark. Pixel or form tracking is almost certainly misfiring.

signals.headline: 94 direction requests, 1 call click
signals.detail: Local interest is strong, but phone taps are near zero. The call-to-action on your Business Profile is not landing.

signals.headline: 138 landing page views from 526 link clicks
signals.detail: Roughly 1 in 4 clicks reach the page. Load speed or redirect issues are burning a quarter of paid traffic.

signals.headline: Pipeline shows $0 opportunity value
signals.detail: Every open opportunity has zero dollars attached and one contact is tagged 'missed-call-texted'. Sales handoff is dropping revenue.
